data.name: Fassold
data.long_meaning: From the Old German words ‘fah’ meaning ‘to hold’ and ‘sal’ meaning ‘salvation’. The name Fassold can be translated as ‘one who holds fast to salvation’ or ‘faithful one’. This name has been historically used in Europe and is popular among Christians.
